notes.title: Sale + Fixes and Adjustments Update
notes.notes:
New Update with some general fixes.

Also Gnome is in the Steam Sale!

First off, updated the Easter Egg:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113557/109331ba2b667aeac36dddb3800b6dfd3def586b.png

Fixed various bugs that you may or may have not noticed. Also fixed the Camera not shaking sometimes and added new camera shake effects to certain events.

Also, added garden gnomes that have an appearance similar to another certain gnome into Survive Society.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362340/Survive_Society/

It's a game where you try to survive in a society by traveling to different areas, one of which is Yard Work that contains the dangerous entity, Garden Gnomes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113557/77afd1609b2a1d06797680d65b8cf928ff2c30e5.png

You can read more about them in this announcement:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3362340/view/613157752262361818

notes.title: Trial Forest Remastered + Settings update
notes.notes:
Alright people, played through this game again recently and wanted to redo the Trial Forest. There's now some puzzles and other things.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113557/be90eecf397d833a798295f17220ad442e122877.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113557/d617697b71afe38c137e0ba90440f434d7364bdf.png

Update and give it another try, if you dare wahahahaha

New Settings
Added and remade certain settings

Screen Choice
Instead of only being able to choose windowed and full screen, you can pick Exclusive Fullscreen, Fullscreen window, Maximized Window and Windowed.

Framerate and Framerate Cap
You can now cap the framerate (so it doesn't play at maximum) and set it.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Reported bugs fixed!

Big Thing:

Removed the Vulkan graphics API. For some reason it always caused a lot of stutters and glitches. It wasn't supposed to be on there but the final build added it. DirectX 12 and 11 are there, it will default to one automatically, if you don't have 12 it will go to 11.

Smaller Things:

Fixed Master Volume not working.
Fixed Background Volume not saving.
Fixed Windowed Toggle to display correctly.
Fixed that weird light that bled through the ceiling on the backyard door. This only affected DirectX 11 and Vulkan


Also added a gnome firework to Firework Simulator:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2271890/view/3720582429629480731
